releaseNotes: Audio engine overhaul: ReplayGain-aware Track/Album normalization, private on-device loudness analysis for untagged tracks, and a true six-band parametric EQ with adjustable frequency, gain, Q, shelves, presets, preamp, automatic headroom, and clipping protection. Local DSP applies to phone/wired/Bluetooth/local Android Auto playback while Cast, DLNA, Roku, and Whole House remain isolated.
